mapper.insert: insert into ai_generation_tasks (merchant_id, store_id, slot_id, slot_key, slot_spec_version, reference_asset_id, generation_type, ai_profile_version, prompt_text, prompt_version, text_content, text_mode, style_preset, placement_preset, size_preset, candidate_count, transparent_background, provider, status, product_id, target_width, target_height, visual_intent_json, requested_by, created_at, updated_at) values (#{merchantId}, #{storeId}, #{slotId}, #{slotKey}, #{slotSpecVersion}, #{referenceAssetId}, #{generationType}, #{aiProfileVersion}, #{promptText}, #{promptVersion}, #{textContent}, #{textMode}, #{stylePreset}, #{placementPreset}, #{sizePreset}, #{candidateCount}, #{transparentBackground}, #{provider}, #{status}, #{productId}, #{targetWidth}, #{targetHeight}, #{visualIntentJson}, #{requestedBy}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update ai_generation_tasks set status=#{status}, error_message=#{errorMessage}, updated_at=now() where id=#{taskId}
mapper.select: select * from ai_generation_tasks where merchant_id=#{merchantId} and id=#{taskId}
mapper.insert: insert into ai_generation_results (merchant_id, task_id, candidate_no, storage_key, mime_type, width, height, source_width, source_height, final_width, final_height, byte_size, checksum_sha256, has_alpha, post_processed, text_validation_status, text_validation_detail, status, expires_at, created_at) values (#{merchantId}, #{taskId}, #{candidateNo}, #{storageKey}, #{mimeType}, #{width}, #{height}, #{sourceWidth}, #{sourceHeight}, #{finalWidth}, #{finalHeight}, #{byteSize}, #{checksumSha256}, #{hasAlpha}, #{postProcessed}, #{textValidationStatus}, #{textValidationDetail}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, now())
mapper.select: select * from ai_generation_results where merchant_id=#{merchantId} and task_id=#{taskId} order by candidate_no
select * from ai_generation_results where merchant_id=#{merchantId} and id=#{resultId}
mapper.update: update ai_generation_results set status='ACCEPTED', accepted_asset_id=#{assetId}, accepted_at=now() where merchant_id=#{merchantId} and id=#{resultId} and accepted_asset_id is null
